english.note: Use 煮食爐 as the all-purpose term for a stove-style cooker.
This is the all-purpose choice for a cooker used to heat food.

examples.english: This cooker is broken, so I can't cook rice.
examples.traditional: 呢個煮食爐壞咗，煮唔到飯。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zyu2 sik6 lou4 waai6 zo2 zyu2 m4 dou2 faan6

examples.english: The stove in my home has broken, so I need to buy a new one.
examples.traditional: 我屋企個煮食爐壞咗，要買個新嘅。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 zyu2 sik6 lou4 waai6 zo2 jiu3 maai5 go3 san1 ge3
